content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to CAPM Certification in Henderson

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: CAPM requires a secondary degree (high school diploma, associate, or equivalent) and completion of required project management education hours. No prior work experience is necessary—making CAPM ideal for career-changers and professionals new to project management entering Henderson's growing sectors.

steps_items.heading: Complete 23 Hours of Instruction
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led boot-camp-style course. Designed for working professionals, the intensive format condenses foundational project management knowledge into a focused schedule you can complete without relocating or commuting.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After finishing your education, submit your formal application to PMI and pay the exam registration fee. Granite PM Academy guides you through each requirement to ensure your application is complete and accepted promptly.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Take the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources to review PMBOK Guide content, practice questions, and test-taking strategies. You'll sit for the proctored CAPM exam when ready, earning your credential upon passing.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential
steps_items.text: CAPM credentials renew on a three-year cycle. Earn professional development units through PMI-approved training, volunteer work, or professional involvement. Granite PM Academy offers ongoing PDU opportunities to keep your certification current and relevant.

fq_items.question: Do I need project management experience to take the CAPM?
fq_items.answer: No prior PM experience is required. The CAPM only requires secondary education (high school diploma or equivalent) and 23 contact hours of project management education — which our course fulfills.

fq_items.question: Is the CAPM a good starting credential for {city} professionals?
fq_items.answer: Yes. The CAPM is one of the most recognized entry-level PM credentials and is highly regarded across industries in {city_state}. It demonstrates PM knowledge to employers even before you have years of experience.

fq_items.question: How does the CAPM differ from the PMP?
fq_items.answer: The PMP requires 36–60 months of project leadership experience; the CAPM does not. Many professionals earn the CAPM early in their career, gain experience, then pursue the PMP.

fq_items.question: Is this training delivered online?
